scope: truthful demo slice: EX-CH01-S01 through EX-CH01-S03; not a complete Chapter 1

chapter.title: Night One
chapter.subtitle: A crew becomes responsible for something small.
chapter.summary: Commission Aurora, plant Alo and Tara, prepare for a 36-hour scenario night and survive a labelled historical storm replay. First bloom closes the night and opens the mystery of N.

scenes.title: Sunlight We Cannot Keep

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.line: A full battery sounds like a good problem.

dialogue.speaker: Amara
dialogue.line: Only if we notice what spills.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.line: Can we store it somewhere that is not a battery?

dialogue.speaker: Ferreira (Earth link)
dialogue.line: Show each other your reasoning, then commit it.

player_actions: Compare air-tank and planting-light routes, then confirm one.
Read the charter and acknowledge emergency limits.

choice.prompt: Where should spare commissioning energy go?

options.label: STORE AIR
options.consequence: The air gauge rises in this exercise.

options.label: LIGHT THE PLANTING BAY
options.consequence: The planting bench receives warm light.

choice.convergence: Both preserve the later April 25 survival baseline; their visible commissioning results persist until the dated transition.

learning.transfer: Check where energy can be used or stored before treating it as spare.

scenes.title: The Rule That Works Without Earth
scenes.location: Mission table and Safe Room doorway

dialogue.speaker: Rafi
dialogue.line: These are names. We do not spend them.

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.line: And if Earth cannot hear the roll call?

dialogue.speaker: Amara
dialogue.line: The station still can. So can we.

dialogue.speaker: Ferreira (Earth link)
dialogue.line: You have local authority to stop an unsafe operation.

player_actions: Classify local, stored and live-link information.
Rehearse bench shutdown and four-person roll call.
Resolve the practice fault without live-link hints.

options.label: AMARA
options.consequence: Her read-back tests a second user of the procedure.

choice.convergence: All four confirm the same local response.

learning.transfer: A school emergency plan should not depend on one phone.

scenes.title: A Label Older Than Our Names

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.line: Alo means light. Someone named the packet before us.

dialogue.speaker: Rafi
dialogue.line: And a reference before the interesting number.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.line: A sealed experiment grew a cotton seedling on the Moon in 2019. We are building on that beginning.

player_actions: Inspect seal, record and inscription without damaging the packet.
Compare both chamber atmosphere diagrams and distinguish the historical cotton germination record from the expedition flowering goal.

learning.transfer: Check how an instrument was zeroed before relying on it.
